bifrost: springboard/src/shell/camera/mod.rs (webcam viewfinder, V4L2), springboard/src/media/capture.rs, springboard/src/media/v4l2.rs, springboard/apps/photocraft-desktop
summary: ImageCaptureCore finds and controls PTP cameras and scanners over USB and imports their files. BifrOSt has no PTP, MTP, camera-device or scanner stack and no SDK API for these devices. Its only camera path is a V4L2 webcam viewfinder that saves JPEGs into the Photos folder.

features.note: Wave 2 (theme-33, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No API to browse cameras or scanners and get add/remove callbacks. capture.rs only lists video nodes and opens nothing.

gaps: No device browser: no API or system service that enumerates PTP cameras and scanners and reports hotplug events (ICDeviceBrowser).
No PTP or MTP transport, so no camera file listing, download, delete or tethered capture (ICCameraDevice, ICCameraFile).
No scanner transport (SANE or similar) and no scan job API (ICScannerDevice).
No per-app USB device grant to match com.apple.security.device.usb in springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs.
Camera permission model: no usage-description string or prompt for camera access, unlike NSCameraUsageDescription.
Photos import from a device is absent; springboard/apps/photocraft-desktop has no import code in this checkout.
